create.name: Acharya Shunya
create.bio:
Acharya Shunya teaches Advaita Vedanta and the Goddess traditions of India as head of the Sarayu Parampara, a householder lineage from Ayodhya, and she is the first woman to hold that role. Her grandfather, Acharya Ayodhya Nath, began training her when she was nine, and she studied with him daily for fourteen years before carrying the teachings to the West. In 2007 she set up Vedika Global, a California nonprofit, and she has written three books for Sounds True, among them Sovereign Self, a guide to the Upanishads and the Gita, and Roar Like a Goddess, on the feminine archetypes of Hindu scripture.

From the San Francisco Bay Area she leads two online circles: the Inner Mandala, built around Sunday satsangs on the four yogas of devotion, action, meditation and Self-knowledge, and the Goddess Unbound Circle for women and nonbinary students. A monthly Veda Sangha is open to anyone on a donation basis, and her podcast Shadow to Self carries longer talks. She has taught at Kripalu, Omega and Stanford, and her students now come from more than twenty countries. Her style is scholarly but warm, grounded in scripture, mantra and contemplation rather than technique.

books.title: Sovereign Self: Claim Your Inner Joy and Freedom with the Empowering Wisdom of the Vedas, Upanishads, and Bhagavad Gita
books.author: Acharya Shunya
books.description: A long, practical introduction to nondual Vedic teaching, drawing on the Upanishads and the Bhagavad Gita to show how a sense of self built on fear and approval can give way to inner freedom. Published by Sounds True in 2020.

books.title: Roar Like a Goddess: Every Woman's Guide to Becoming Unapologetically Powerful, Prosperous, and Peaceful
books.author: Acharya Shunya
books.description: Uses the great goddess figures of Indian scripture, such as Durga, Kali, Lakshmi and Saraswati, as mirrors for women reclaiming confidence, dignity and spiritual authority. Each chapter pairs a story with reflections and practices.

courses.title: Inner Mandala Vedic Study Circle: Full Membership
courses.description: Her main ongoing online sangha, with live Sunday satsangs on the four yogas, companion classes led by teachers she has trained, a large recorded archive and a members' community. Sessions are on Zoom and recorded.
courses.price: $108 USD a month or $1,080 USD a year

courses.title: Goddess Unbound Circle
courses.description: A membership circle for women and nonbinary students studying Shakti through Goddess scripture, sacred practice and self-inquiry, with two live online gatherings a month, a recorded library and a private forum. The founding circle begins on 9 January 2027.
courses.price: $950 USD a year (monthly option, $95 USD deposit)

courses.title: Ancient Meditation for Inner Stillness
courses.description: A self-paced course of nine lessons, about two hours in all, on Vedic ways of drawing the senses inward, quieting the mind and resting in the 'I Am' meditation, with work on mudras and chakras. Hosted by Next Level Soul.

courses.title: Honor the Goddess Within
courses.description: A recorded nine-part journey through the Nava Durga, one form of the Goddess for each day of Navratri, combining story, contemplation, chanting and practice. First taught live to students from six continents in 2021.

courses.title: Roaring Relationships & Self
courses.description: Eight recorded sessions drawing on the figure of Saraswati to look at recurring relationship patterns, honest communication and boundaries, with reflection circles led by one of her senior students.

courses.title: Roaring Abundance and Wealth
courses.description: Four satsangs recorded live in 2023 on Lakshmi and the Vedic view of prosperity, treating money and material life as part of a dharmic path rather than an obstacle to it. Includes guided meditations.

free_resources.title: Acharya Shunya on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Short talks, mantras and guided meditations rooted in Vedanta, including a Self-realization practice based on the Atmabodha. Free to hear in the app or online.

free_resources.title: Open Mandala teaching archive
free_resources.description: A free archive of hundreds of hours of her recorded foundational teachings on Vedanta and Bhakti Yoga, offered through Vedika Global for students who cannot yet join live classes. Entry is by a short application.

free_resources.title: Monthly Veda Sangha
free_resources.description: A free live teaching on a Vedic theme on the second Saturday of each month at 3pm Pacific, on Zoom and streamed to YouTube. Donations are welcome but not required.

free_resources.title: Shadow to Self podcast
free_resources.description: Her podcast on moving from ego-driven suffering towards freedom through the four yogas. The second season looks at Bhakti, Karma, Jnana and Upasana as living practice.

sprint.tier_evidence: Insight Timer 1.9k (profile, 1 Nov 2026); Instagram @acharyashunya 16K (og:description, 1 Nov 2026); Facebook /acharyashunya 11,168 (og:description, 1 Nov 2026); YouTube @acharyashunya 5.74K subscribers (channel header, 1 Nov 2026) → ~34.8k total → local_hero
flags: Possible editorial-stature case for the owner: three Sounds True books (Roar Like a Goddess won an OMMIE award), head of a Vedic lineage, taught at Kripalu, Omega and Stanford; tier left at local_hero by follower total (~34.8k), no override applied.

Availability local_online with city Hayward: her site gives a Hayward street address (108 Shakti Drive) and says she is based in the Bay Area and teaches worldwide; student photos show in-person satsangs, but no current in-person class schedule was found.

Her site also sells Ayurveda Lifestyle Wisdom, whose Amazon subtitle promises to prevent disease, and a free monthly Ayurveda Sangha led by an Ayurveda physician runs through Vedika Global; both left out, but the Ayurveda book page is one click from her website. The main site is framed around Vedanta and Goddess teaching, not conditions, so the plan was written.

Course and video copy uses 'heal past wounds' and 'heal relational wounds' language (Roaring Abundance, Roaring Relationships); kept because no condition is named, and my descriptions leave the healing wording out.
Inner Mandala and Open Mandala live on vedikaglobal.org, her nonprofit's site, not acharyashunya.com.
Ancient Meditation for Inner Stillness is hosted on Next Level Soul; her site links an affiliate URL, the plan uses the plain course page.
left_out: Ayurveda Lifestyle Wisdom (Sounds True, 2017, ASIN 1622038274): subtitle 'A Complete Prescription to Optimize Your Health, Prevent Disease…', health rule.
Sitayana / Sita's Gems audiobook: no amazon.com /dp/ listing confirmed.
Four Thresholds of Shakti (12 Sep–19 Dec 2026), Inner Mandala 4-Sunday Trial (Oct 2026 dates), Navratri 2026: already started by the sprint date.
Monthly Ayurveda Sangha: led by another teacher (Vaidya Vimala) and Ayurveda-health focused.
Insight Timer tracks titled for grief and sorrow ('Coping With Grief & Death', 'Addressing Sorrow…'): not listed individually anyway; profile link only.

YouTube: Ram Dass retreat promo (2:11), Diwali and Ayurveda Day greetings, Ayurveda Day poem (under 3 min or seasonal), and the Kabbalah dialogue and Shamini Jain conversation (shared speaking) left out.
